app_rls_executor.purpose: Owns approved RLS tables, partitions, sequences and bounded lifecycle routines.

app_security_owner.purpose: Owns app_secure views and approved SECURITY DEFINER or trigger routines.

auth_runtime.decision: Dedicated privilege group for pre-tenant authentication bootstrap and session lifecycle. Deployment logins may inherit this role together with ordinary application groups, but auth_runtime itself is NOLOGIN and must never own schema objects, bypass RLS, or be granted to migration_owner.
auth_runtime.purpose: Least-privilege pre-tenant authentication/bootstrap and auth-session capability for tenant-root creation.

lifecycle_maintenance_runtime.decision: Dedicated cross-tenant lifecycle-maintenance capability group. Deployment maintenance logins may inherit this role, but lifecycle_maintenance_runtime is NOLOGIN/NOBYPASSRLS, owns no schema objects, has no API/auth/queue-worker membership, and must never be granted to migration_owner.
lifecycle_maintenance_runtime.purpose: Bounded watchdog and search-reconciliation maintenance capability gated by transaction-local lifecycle maintenance context.

migration_owner.decision: Production migration_owner is a reduced NOINHERIT/NOBYPASSRLS login. Required owner transitions are explicit per-membership SET edges with INHERIT FALSE; Alembic must fail closed rather than rely on implicit role inheritance or RLS bypass.
migration_owner.purpose: Ordinary reduced Alembic migration identity after privileged cluster bootstrap.

ops_support.decision: REMOVE BYPASSRLS. Support access must remain tenant- and RLS-scoped. Any cross-tenant or break-glass operation requires a separately authorized, audited administrative workflow or narrow SECURITY DEFINER interface. The group must own no object and must never be granted to migration_owner.
ops_support.purpose: Operational support group; source currently contains broad BYPASSRLS.

worker_runtime.decision: Dedicated asynchronous-worker privilege group. Deployment worker logins may inherit this role, but worker_runtime is NOLOGIN/NOBYPASSRLS, owns no schema objects, is not a member of API/auth roles, and must never be granted to migration_owner.
worker_runtime.purpose: Bounded cross-tenant queue claim and tenant-scoped background processing capability.

internal_billing_worker.decision: Retired in P2B after repository-wide usage tracing found no active application, migration, grant, ownership, or deployment binding. Historical inventory remains evidence only; current clusters must remove the role through the audited infrastructure change process before HEAD verification can pass.
internal_billing_worker.reason: Obsolete Platform Billing capability from historical inventory; superseded by current isolated billing/runtime boundaries.
